title: Height setting micrometers and rising blocks
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 13907) covers Height setting micrometers and rising blocks. This Indian Standard which is identical with ISO 7863 : 1984 'Height setting micrometers and rfeer blocks', issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) was adopted by the Bureau of Ind&rfStandards on the recommendation of the Engineering Metrology Sectional Committee (LM 05) and approval of the Light Mechanical Engineering Division Council. Height setting micrometer is a measuring instrument comprising a substantial housing which carries a vertical movable column, positioned by a micrometer screw, with measuring elements provided with regularly spaced, alternative orcoplaner measuring faces. The standard specif iesthecharacteristics of height setting micrometer with a measuring capacity up to 600 mm and a minimum scale value not greater than 2 p.m together with riser blocks up to 600 mm in height.
